title: The Day of Unreasonable Green
skyStory: A waxing gibbous moon, seventy-two percent lit, floats in Cancer and squints at the town below, which has turned alarmingly green overnight. Green hats. Green scarves. A green dog, somehow. The moon is not sure what holiday this is, but it loves a party and decides to glow a little brighter in solidarity. Jupiter, always up for fun, starts a fiddle tune.

reading: Today rewards anyone brave enough to wear something completely ridiculous. Not subtle green. Unreasonable green. The Tiger looks magnificent in it, obviously, and the moon is watching from Cancer, ready to applaud the commitment.

Midafternoon, someone will start telling a story and lose the thread halfway through. Jump in and finish it for them, gloriously, with a much better ending than they planned. Life Path 3 was made for exactly this. The room will laugh. The storyteller will laugh hardest. Then hand the spotlight right back with a bow, like a fiddler passing the tune to the next player.
joel.mission: Wear the most unreasonably green item you own and, when complimented, claim it was a gift from the moon.
joel.omen: A four-leaf clover, real or drawn. It means luck is following you around today like a friendly golden retriever.

reading: There is a fiddle tune somewhere in your day, and your hands will find the rhythm before your brain does. The Wood Rat is a secret dancer. Let her out, even if it is only a little shuffle in the kitchen while the kettle boils.

Late in the day, someone you have helped will mention, out of the blue, that they are doing much better at something because of you. You will try to deflect. Do not. Say thank you, and then tell them one specific thing you noticed about how hard they worked. The [[Three of Cups]] is raising a glass in your honour. Clink it back.
nancy.mission: Do a ten-second kitchen jig while the kettle boils, then pour your drink with a dramatic flourish.
nancy.omen: A rainbow, painted or real. It means a happy surprise is waiting at the end of today, not tomorrow.

together.text: Unreasonable green day. Each of you photograph the greenest thing you see before sundown and send it over. The winner earns the right to name the next fog bank that rolls in. It must be named something gloriously fancy.
